advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a behavioral test exercising context propagation for the run_workflow daemon path (or a direct spawn_context_daemon unit test asserting a ContextVar set in the caller is visible inside the spawned thread), so the ff4a regression for _mcp_writes.py is caught by behavior, not just a source-text scan.
evidence: tests/unit/test_opcert_binding_thread_propagation_ff4a.py:127 "A behavioural test cannot reach it: that daemon is a closure inside a nested FastMCP tool function with no importable seam."

tests/unit/test_opcert_binding_thread_propagation_ff4a.py:160-164 scan appends offenders and asserts `not offenders` — it inspects the source text of _mcp_*.py, never executes the spawn or checks that context actually crosses the thread boundary

src/rebar/_mcp_writes.py:605 `spawn_context_daemon(_bg, name=f"rebar-workflow-{run_id}")` is an added line whose context-propagation behavior is unverified by any test that would fail if spawn_context_daemon regressed
advisory.finding: The run_workflow daemon in _mcp_writes.py (the second, added spawn_context_daemon call, and half of the ff4a defect) has no behavioral test; its only regression guard is the AST source-scan test_no_mcp_tool_daemon_spawns_a_bare_thread, which asserts the CALL-SITE SPELLING in executable source rather than the observed context-propagation contract. It is a change-detector by Rule-4 (breaks on a behavior-preserving refactor that moves the spawn into a helper module outside the _mcp_*.py glob) and is regression-blind to the real failure mode: it would stay green even if spawn_context_daemon stopped propagating the context, since it only checks that threading.Thread is not called directly.
scenarios: A refactor extracts the daemon spawn to a shared helper module (not matching `_mcp_*.py`): the guard silently stops covering it while spelling changes
spawn_context_daemon is later changed to use a plain Thread internally, dropping context — the scan still passes because the call site keeps its name
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a direct unit test for spawn_context_daemon: set a ContextVar in the caller, spawn a target that reads it into a shared dict, join, and assert the value crossed the boundary — this verifies the contract the structural scan cannot.
